Material 3 color used by the alert component for dismiss hover foreground.
Material 3 color used by the alert component for dismiss active foreground.

color.$description: Material 3 color used by the alert component for focus ring color.

padding.$description: Material 3 has no frame around the alert: the shell takes no padding, so the card is the one container.

radius.$description: Material 3 shell radius matches the 12dp card it no longer frames.

bg.$description: Material 3 shell paints nothing: the card is the one container.

shadow.$description: Material 3 alert card is flat (container elevation level0), so the shadow is transparent and the alert reads as one box.
